'''Hydan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] who was part of the crew of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' during its mission to hunt down [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. Several weeks into the mission, Hydan was responsible for decrypting a transmission from Sarne to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rolf Treidum]] indicating that they would meet in the [[Episol system]].
